note: The session's web-search allowance ran out after six candidates, so the rest were looked up only on pages reachable directly (the governments' and school districts' own sites, and a few guessed campaign addresses). A blank here means not looked up fully, not that nothing exists. Pages that refused a script (michigan.gov press releases, Ballotpedia, corpmagazine.com) were left alone.

official_page.source: Saginaw County: the 10th Circuit Court's page lists "Hon. Manvel Trice III" among its five circuit judges

offices.office: Judge of the Saginaw County District Court (appointed by the Governor)
offices.source: Saginaw Valley State University newsroom, May 30, 2017: "Gov. Rick Snyder appointed Trice as a Saginaw County District Court judge in 2016". The page does not say when he left that court; the county's page shows him on the 10th Circuit Court today
